# Smart LGSTX

> Smart LGSTX is a contingency-based shipping cost optimization firm that helps businesses reduce their UPS and FedEx spending by 10–20%. Founded by Chris Tweedy, a former carrier executive with 15+ years on the carrier side, Smart LGSTX audits shipping contracts and negotiates on behalf of shippers. No upfront cost — clients pay only when savings are achieved.

## Who We Help

Businesses spending $100K–$5MM annually with major small parcel carriers (UPS, FedEx) who want to reduce shipping costs without switching carriers or changing operations.

## What We Do

- Free shipping contract audit — identifies overpayments across 250+ contract line items
- Expert carrier contract negotiation using insider knowledge of what carriers will actually concede
- Surcharge reduction: large package fees, additional handling, residential delivery, dimensional weight, demand surcharges, and more
- Ongoing contract monitoring and renegotiation support

## Business Model

Contingency-based: Smart LGSTX earns a percentage of the savings achieved. If there are no savings, there is no fee.
